description: A p5.js builder for xAPI activity IRIs. Learners combine the canonical site_url, a page path and an optional fragment for a control, diagram node, fixed-order or shuffled question; see that the browser's address never changes the IRI; and apply five documented mistakes to watch the offending segment turn red and one learner's visit split into two rows in a store's grouping.
audience: Teachers, instructional designers, learning-technology developers and learning-analytics practitioners (college undergraduate and professional development)

learningObjectives: The learner will construct a correct activity IRI for a page, a control and a question, and diagnose why a malformed IRI is wrong.
prerequisites: The object part of an xAPI statement (Chapter 16)

accessibility.notes: All inputs are native text fields, selects and a button reachable by Tab; mistakes are explained in words as well as by red color

controls.label: site_url
controls.purpose: The canonical base address; a missing trailing slash is added

controls.label: Reset
controls.purpose: Return every control to its default

controls.label: Sub-activity
controls.purpose: none, control, node, fixed-order question or shuffled question

controls.label: Sub-activity name or number
controls.purpose: Slugified or numbered into the fragment

controls.label: Loaded from
controls.purpose: published site, local preview or iframe payload main.html (changes only the address bar)

controls.label: Show a mistake
controls.purpose: Apply one of five documented IRI mistakes

controls.label: IRI segments
controls.purpose: Click to read the rule behind a segment

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Construction practice with worked counter-examples and visible consequences
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Live builder with mistake injection and grouping preview
keyQuestions: Why must the IRI use site_url and not the address the browser shows?
Why does a trailing slash matter to a store?
How should a question in a shuffled quiz be named?
commonMisconceptions: The browser address is the activity identifier
main.html and the page are the same activity
Question numbers can start at zero
assessmentOpportunities: Constructing IRIs for a page, control and question
Naming the consequence of each mistake
Applying the stable-name test to a fragment
